alt: Unedited video recording of the Call the Car mobile application's 'Search Pharmacy' feature, demonstrating a locked 'Within 5 miles' distance dropdown menu. This hard cap prevents L.A. Care members from booking non-medical transportation (NMT) or non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) to any pharmacy located beyond a 5-mile radius, in direct violation of California DHCS All Plan Letter 22-008 (APL 22-008).

full_text:
Video Transcript:
0:00 - Smartphone screen displaying the Call the Car 'Search Pharmacy' interface. The distance dropdown is pre-selected and locked to 'Within 5 miles'.
0:01 - User highlights and attempts to expand the distance dropdown. The menu is unresponsive and locked.
0:02 - The screen displays a filtered list of five pharmacies matching the 5-mile restriction: Walgreens (5001 W Ave N, Lancaster - 0.33 mi), Walmart Pharmacy (3875 Rancho Vista Blvd, Palmdale - 1.53 mi), Quartz Hill Pharmacy (42351 10th St W, Quartz Hill - 1.77 mi), Savon Pharmacy (43543 20th St W, Lancaster - 4.46 mi), and Walmart Pharmacy (40130 10th St W, Palmdale - 4.53 mi).
0:04 - User scrolls down the page, showing the restricted pharmacy selection.
0:06 - End of video.
